name: best_vary_radius
description: Single-axis: induced weakspot gap size. Anchored at the 10-seed joint-search sweet spot (deeper undertrained regime + wide kernel, warm-start): n_bumps 5, noise_std 0.05, radius 0.25, iters_initial 12, n_train 100, sel_sigma 0.5, n_select 100, mix_ratio 0.5, iters_retrain 400, Weakpoint distance. At this anchor guided beats the random baseline over the WHOLE area ~75-85% of the time (gap ~-0.25) and fixes the weakspot hard. Default detector trio = strong, diverse detectors here (Quantile Regression, Peaks over Threshold (EVT), RBF Interpolation); 20 seeds. Sweeps radius finely [0.0..0.26] (0 = no gap) to map how gap size decides whether guided beats random over the whole area vs only inside the gap.
